entrance.name: Dungeon Entrance
entrance.description: Cold air drifts through the ancient stone passage. A narrow stairway leads deeper into darkness.

hall.name: The Long Hall
hall.description: Torches flicker weakly along the walls. The stone beneath your feet is worn smooth by centuries of travelers.

chamber.name: Goblin's Chamber
chamber.description: A foul-smelling chamber filled with broken crates and old bones. Something has been living here.

crossroads.name: The Crossroads
crossroads.description: Four ancient passages meet here. The air is strangely still.

treasure_room.name: Forgotten Treasury
treasure_room.description: Dust-covered stone chests line the walls. Whatever treasures once filled this room are long gone.
